candidate_fix: in the coupling, skip the empty sector in phases 3 and 4 and their checks
effect: feeders and substations with one kind of customer cannot be run

candidate_fix: in the coupling, drop phase count from the building map key, or give each phase count its own building; in dx-sew, one load shape name per phase count at staging
effect: feeders with a shared load shape cannot be run
handling: flagged; never a typical feeder or check substation; a group without a runnable feeder takes the nearest group's typical feeder as a marked placeholder (K61, K62)

case: any case of more than one feeder
cause: phase 4 draws buildings once for the whole case
effect: the same feeder receives other buildings when its case holds other feeders, so a typical feeder run alone and the same feeder inside its substation are different draws; at the pin most of a tested feeder's parquets changed building
handling: stated as a known limitation; typical feeders run alone, and the check set runs whole substations
retest: run one typical feeder alone and inside its substation through phase 4 at the new pin and compare bldg_id per parquet

symptom: each season's run cuts the days of both seasons, and the year-long phases run once per season
cause: the season loop runs the whole phase list per season
candidate_fix: run the year-long phases once per case
retest: retested at f7f1171 (job J10): unchanged; each season's run of the reference substation still runs the year-long phases, and its winter run took about as long as its summer run (batch tables)

case: any command started inside another uv environment
symptom: uv run prints that VIRTUAL_ENV does not match and ignores it
cause: the outer environment's variable is inherited

symptom: the columns P_3ph (kW), Q_3ph (kVAr) and S_3ph (kVA) of aggregate_m1.csv are empty in every row
cause: the m1 monitor records voltage and current per phase (V, VAngle, I, IAngle), not S and Ang, so the step that computes P and Q skips every phase of m1, and the column reorder then adds the three total columns with no values
candidate_fix: in the coupling, compute P and Q only where S and Ang are present and leave the total columns out of aggregate_m1.csv otherwise
effect: none on results; aggregate_m2.csv holds P and Q per phase and in total, and aggregate_m1.csv only looks as if it held power
handling: read active and reactive power from aggregate_m2.csv
retest: retested at f7f1171 (job J10): unchanged; 7_circuit_instantiation/aggregate_m1.csv of the reference substation still has P_3ph (kW), Q_3ph (kVAr) and S_3ph (kVA) empty in every row of both seasons

case: two cases that download into the same folder at once, or a download that fails part way
symptom: a partial building file stays in the download folder and is skipped by every later run
cause: phase 5a writes each building file under its final name while it downloads, and the only test before a download is whether that name exists
candidate_fix: in the coupling, download under a temporary name and rename it when complete, or check the file size against the listing before skipping it
effect: phase 5b cannot read the partial file, prints Error reading and leaves the building out of the feeder sum, so the feeder's curve and peak day change with no failure
handling: dx-sew runs the downloading phases (pre to 5a) one case at a time (K69), and its year-curve rebuild (K66) stops on a file it cannot read
retest: retested at f7f1171 (job J10): unchanged; phase 5a still writes each building file under its final name and skips on the name alone: https://github.com/DeltaE/dss-eulp-coupling/blob/f7f117154d4580d506e5f227ad70c64dab723ffc/5a_eulp_downloads/download_parquets_residential_impl.py#L123-L130 ; https://github.com/DeltaE/dss-eulp-coupling/blob/f7f117154d4580d506e5f227ad70c64dab723ffc/5a_eulp_downloads/download_parquets_residential_impl.py#L221-L223 ; https://github.com/DeltaE/dss-eulp-coupling/blob/f7f117154d4580d506e5f227ad70c64dab723ffc/5a_eulp_downloads/download_parquets_commercial_impl.py#L131-L138 ; https://github.com/DeltaE/dss-eulp-coupling/blob/f7f117154d4580d506e5f227ad70c64dab723ffc/5a_eulp_downloads/download_parquets_commercial_impl.py#L231-L234
